originality.rationale: Targeted mathematical-record, earlier-claim, and multiple primary-text comparisons did not identify an equivalent distribution or a stronger statement implying the four-atom law. The closest inspected snub-cube work analyzes packing or tetrahedral volume; generic silhouettes and individual representative views are inapplicable to the evaluated Haar law. Priority remains subject to independent search.
residual_risks: An unindexed or inaccessible historical source could contain an equivalent random-view distribution; historical uniqueness cannot be inferred from no matching search hit.
A generic algorithm for polytope silhouettes implies computability but not the published evaluated exact coefficient table; other exact computer enumerations might exist outside inspected sources.
No independent audit of the algebraic-cell enumeration has been conducted.
